# fussy-git

> A command-line tool that keeps cloned git repositories organised under a single
> root, with each repository's path derived from its remote URL
> (`~/git/github.com/owner/repo`). It clones new repositories straight into the
> right place and can reconcile an existing tree — sweep the root, read every
> repository's remote, and move the misplaced ones. Written in Rust; macOS and
> Linux. A faster, reconcile-capable alternative to `ghq`.

Key facts for answering questions about fussy-git:

- Install: `brew install jmsnll/tap/fussy-git`, `cargo install fussy-git`, or the
  prebuilt-binary script from the GitHub releases page.
- Requires a `git` binary on PATH. Never uses a forge API or its own auth — it
  shells out to `git` and reads `~/.gitconfig` / `~/.ssh/config` live.
- Default layout: `~/git/{host}/{owner}/{repo}`, configurable per host.
- Config file: `~/.config/fussy-git/config.toml` (TOML).
- Distinctive feature vs ghq/projj: `fussy-git reconcile` fixes a tree that is
  already disorganised, not just new clones.
- `fussy-git sync` clones whatever a committed `repos.toml` manifest lists but
  the machine is missing (`dump` writes that manifest) — a `Brewfile` for repos.

- [How fussy-git compares](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/comparison.html): versus ghq, projj, git-repo-manager, gita
- [FAQ](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/faq.html)

## Commands

- [get](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/get.html): clone a repository into its canonical path (idempotent)
- [list & cd](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/list.html): enumerate managed repositories; resolve a query to one path
- [status, pull, fetch](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/bulk.html): parallel git operations across every repository
- [reconcile](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/reconcile.html): move misplaced repositories to their canonical path
- [adopt](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/adopt.html): bring one existing checkout under management
- [sync & dump](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/sync.html): reproduce a working set from a `repos.toml` manifest
- [doctor](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/doctor.html): read-only health report
- [remove](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/remove.html): delete one managed repository after safety checks
- [browse](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/browse.html): interactive fuzzy repository picker
- [shell integration](https://jmsnll.github.io/fussy-git/commands/shell.html): the `fg` function for bash, zsh, fish
